title: Replace NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE with safeResolveWorkspaceRoot across 11 files (SEC-002)
description: 11 source files directly read NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env var with only trim() — no path traversal validation. Replace all with safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() from shared module which does path.resolve + containment check.
action: In each of the 11 source files, replace local resolveWorkspaceRoot()/getWorkspaceRoot()/resolveWorkflowWorkspace() functions with import { safeResolveWorkspaceRoot } from '../mcp/input-validation.js' (adjusting relative path per file location). Remove the local function definition. Call safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() where the local function was called. Files: reader-endpoints.ts, agent.ts, chat.ts, critic.ts, graph.ts, memory.ts, workflow.ts, wiki.ts, workspace.ts, workflow-revision.ts, workflow.ts (services), revision-service.ts

implementation: For each of the 11 source files:

1. Add import: import { safeResolveWorkspaceRoot } from '<relative-path>/mcp/input-validation.js' — adjust relative path: endpoints/* uses '../input-validation.js', services/* uses '../input-validation.js', reader/mcp uses '../../mcp/input-validation.js', services/revision uses '../mcp/input-validation.js'
3. Replace all call sites with safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() — for files that pass the result to normalizeProjectWorkspaceContext, use safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() as the workspaceRoot value
4. In chat.ts line 212: replace 'const override = String(process.env['NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE'] ?? '').trim(); return override || process.cwd();' with 'return safeResolveWorkspaceRoot();'
5. In revision-service.ts line 398: replace inline env read with safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() call
After all replacements: grep to confirm zero NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE references in source files (test files excluded)

success_metrics: existing tests pass (some may need fixture path adjustments)

reference.pattern: All 11 files follow the same pattern: String(process.env['NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE'] ?? '').trim() || process.cwd()

rationale.chosen_approach: Replace all 11 local functions with one shared safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() that adds path.resolve + containment check. This eliminates the entire class of path traversal vulnerabilities at the source.
decision_factors: 11 duplicate implementations are a maintenance burden
Single import change per file is low-risk
tradeoffs: Wide blast radius — 11 files modified at once; mitigated by mechanical find-replace pattern

risks.risk: Existing tests that set NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE to paths outside cwd will fail the containment check
risks.mitigation: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot uses process.cwd() as default allowed root; tests can set env to subdirectories of cwd or pass explicit allowedRoot. Adjust test fixtures in TASK-007.

risks.risk: Import path differs per file location — easy to get wrong
risks.mitigation: Use consistent relative paths: endpoints/ -> '../input-validation.js', services/ -> '../input-validation.js', reader/mcp/ -> '../../mcp/input-validation.js', services/ -> '../mcp/input-validation.js'

affected_features: All MCP endpoints and services using workspace paths
affected_components: 11 source files across endpoints, services, and reader
